description: This file defines a Java interface named WriteStream, which declares a method for writing bytes to an output stream with proper exception handling.

classes.name: WriteStream
classes.description: An interface for a byte stream capable of writing data, with a blocking write method that can throw an IOException.

methods.name: write
methods.description: A method to transmit a byte array to an output stream, blocking until complete and throwing IOException on failure.

parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: The data bytes to be written
